text:
laura: Quick ping — opened a small cleanup PR that splits /src/lib into smaller 'surface' modules and consolidates a couple of barrel exports. Mostly move/rename + re-exports. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2487. Can someone glance for hidden export/typing regressions or circular import risks?

sam: on my list, will take a look in ~30m.

priya: can you call out which files touched the most? makes it easier to triage.

laura: main churn is in lib/index.ts -> split into lib/core.ts, lib/utils.ts, lib/surface/index.ts. also touched auth/ and telemetry/ import lines. total ~18 files but most are tiny re-export changes.

kevin: i can check for barrel issues. quick tip: look for `export * from './foo'` chains that might create cycles. saw those bite us before.

ciara: i'll run a local build and typecheck now — will post results.

sam: quick skim: tests pass locally for me, but watch runtime imports in server start — sometimes circulars only show up under NODE_ENV=production.

laura: noted — ci job triggered. cc @deploy-bot for the CI status.

deploy-bot: CI started for PR #2487 — checks: build, lint, unit-tests, e2e-smoke. https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/2487

ciara: build + typecheck green on my machine. one lint error in telemetry/index.ts (unused re-export).

priya: thanks — i'll open a follow-up to remove the unused export if you want to keep this PR minimal.

laura: yeah prefer follow-up. i kept one questionable re-export to avoid touching callsites in other repos. i'll add a TODO with a comment.

kevin: left two review comments about avoiding `export *` for the surface index — prefer explicit named exports to make future refactors easier. small code example in PR: 
```ts
// prefer this
export { formatTs, parseTs } from './time';
// instead of
export * from './time';
```

sam: also flagged a rename that might affect the telemetry ingestion path — see telemetry/processor -> telemetry/ingest rename. tests still pass but worth verifying downstream consumers.

laura: good catch. i added a note in the PR description and a link to the migration grep command I used: `rg "telemetry/processor" -n || true`.

priya: approved for the style/typing side from me — left one tiny comment about a var name.

kevin: approved from exports side after the explicit export change.

sam: i'll do the final merge after CI is all green and no flaky e2e failures. planning to merge around EOD unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

laura: sounds good — thanks all for quick turns. i'll follow up with the small cleanup PR removing the unused re-export.

ciara: :rocket:

deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #2487. All checks green.

sam: merged. thanks everyone.

laura: thank you! will monitor telemetry dashboards for next deploy window.
